component_guidelines.buttons: Primary buttons must be pure #FF5A00 with #FFFFFF text. Use pill shape (rounded-full). Height minimum 56px for tap targets.
component_guidelines.product_cards: Bold, round product cards with drop shadow. White background, image takes up top 60% with full bleed. Generous padding for text area below.
component_guidelines.bottom_nav: Simple, uncluttered UI. White background, orange active state. Use custom abstract geometric SVG icons, NEVER generic shopping bags or standard houses.
component_guidelines.inputs: Height 56px, background #F7F7F7, borderless by default. Add 2px #FF5A00 border on focus.
component_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Use 'Control Room' dense grid strategy. Minimal shadows, 1px borders (#EAEAEA). Sidebar navigation. Use standard web UI components heavily customized to match the typography and #FF5A00 accent color.

custom_icon_instructions.home: Do not use a generic house. Use nested arches or an abstract doorway geometry (using react-native-svg or standard svg for web).
custom_icon_instructions.cart: Do not use a shopping bag or standard cart. Use a dynamic sweeping arc with a geometric cargo block or a minimalist stylized basket weave.
custom_icon_instructions.orders: Do not use a generic receipt icon. Use a staggered timeline (dots and lines) or a layered abstract log.
custom_icon_instructions.profile: Do not use a generic person silhouette. Use a minimal floating identity orbit or abstract asymmetric portrait shapes.

image_urls.description: Abstract 3D floating grocery items for login/signup or welcome screen.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, touchables, cart increment/decrement).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #FF5A00 text is only used on #FFFFFF backgrounds, or use white text on #FF5A00 backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React Native Expo hybrid app.
Build the mobile application screens: Login/Signup, Home (Categories + Products), Cart, Checkout, Order Confirmation, Orders List, Profile.
Build a separate Admin Web Dashboard (using React/Next or Web UI) for Product CRUD and Order Management.
MANDATORY: Use pure Orange (#FF5A00) and White as the primary UI colors, as explicitly requested by the user.
MANDATORY: Do NOT use standard icons (like FontAwesome shopping-bag) for the bottom nav. You must use SVG primitives to draw custom geometric shapes based on the 'custom_icon_instructions'.
MANDATORY: Ensure generous spacing (e.g., gap-4 or gap-6) and use bold, rounded cards (border-radius: 24px) with soft drop shadows for product listings.
MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to all core functionalities to ensure automated tests pass.
